entities.name: Christian Friedrich Wilhelm von Ompteda

entities.summary: Colonel Christian Friedrich Wilhelm von Ompteda was a Hanoverian army officer who served in the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars. He fought in both the Hanoverian and British armies during the conflict.
